title: Using Formal and Informal Speech and Writing

instruction.text: Decide whether formal or informal texts are more suitable for the scenarios.

atoms.b: writing a letter to the Prime Minister

instruction.text: Does the writing use formal or informal language?

atoms.a:
To whom it may concern,

I am writing to you to complain about the service I received yesterday evening at your restaurant. I am appalled at the attitude of your staff and the quality of your food was a real disappointment.

Yours sincerely,
Mr Taylor
Hey! How’s it going? Fancy meeting up later for a coffee? It’s been sooooo long - I’ve not seen you in ages! I’m dying to see you. Plz drop me a text back, and I’ll give you the deets!

This essay will discuss the advantages and disadvantages of renewable energy. Although renewable energy is the more ideal option, it is expensive to implement and to run. This means that it is not accessible for everyone.
Hi Grandad, how are you? I hope you’ve been keeping well. I really want to see you, could I pop round on Friday afternoon for a cuppa? Let me know if that works for you. Speak soon!
